test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the speeds of two scooters is 9 ∶ 5. If the second scooter runs 75 km in 6 hours, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the first scooter?
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the speeds of two scooters is 9 ∶ 5.

The second scooter runs 75 km in 6 hours.

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Speed of the second scooter = 75/6 = 25/2 km/h

Now, the speed of the first scooter = 9 × (25/2 ÷ 5) = 22.5 km/h

∴ The speed of the first scooter is 22.5 km.
